title: Extractive Summarization of Long Documents by Combining Global and Local Context
answer_short: local context: the topic segment; global context: the whole document
answer_rationale: Text 5 and Text 6 define local context as the section/topic and global context as the whole document. Text 4 and Text 7 further reinforce this by describing how these contexts are combined in the model. Text 2 and Text 3 note that local context contributes significantly to performance, while global context does not, but still define both terms in context.
